title: Hello BadCode Picks
eyebrow: Hello, I'm BadCode · the reel · round 11
heading: The reel, made real
intro: Your timeline note: the reel's AI stills are slop and boring, use Unsplash and real footage. Here are 44 real Commons clips and stills plus 50 Unsplash photos, one row per theme. Pick the best in each row; name extras in the note. Only your picks get downloaded, then rough cut 6.

sections.lede: The reel, made real (your note: "ai slop and boring… use unsplash… also use real footage"). One row per theme. A-numbers are real footage from Wikimedia Commons: free to publish, sound stripped; for a video you see one frame only, nothing's been watched yet. U- photos are real Unsplash photos; Flow would give them a little movement, with nothing added to the picture. Only your picks get downloaded. Orange = a face, a burned-in logo or gore. Six rejected before this page (faces fill the frame, or the licence doesn't hold). Shortlist: research/footage-automation-shortlist.md.

groups.title: How the logo arrives: four new ways
groups.line: Pick one (or a, b, c from the first three, below).

opts.label: d: roll in: each letter rolls in like a wheel and lands, then the ring rolls in, the triangle pops
e: the dot leads: the red-dot o rolls across, each letter pops up as it passes, the dot rolls home, the ring drops in
f: watching you: the ring appears, the red triangle glances round inside it like an eye, then looks at you
g: dial spin: the ring spins in like a dial with the triangle orbiting, lands on its spot, the letters roll in

sections.lede: Each one is 3 s and passes the flashing check. The logo itself is never redrawn, only moved and scaled.
